purpose: Test fresh Treasury-futures momentum/reversion hypotheses on native CBOT contracts without synthetic continuous-series stitching.

data.contract_selection: For each product and signal session, choose the nearest standard single outright Future with at least 21 calendar days to last_trade_date. Exclude tickers containing ':' or '-'.
data.native_contract_rule: The full feature lookback, entry and exit for a portfolio observation must remain on the same selected native contract for each product. If any leg crosses a contract roll, that observation is ineligible. No back-adjustment or stitched price series.
data.missing_rule: Every required session bar must exist exactly. No interpolation, alternate contract rescue or skipped-session substitution.

execution.return_bps: direction * (exit_open / entry_open - 1) * 10000 minus weighted native-tick friction

RATES_H1_XS_MOM5_VOLNORM_HOLD5.feature: sum of prior 5 same-contract close-to-close log returns divided by (sample std of prior 20 same-contract daily log returns * sqrt(5))
RATES_H1_XS_MOM5_VOLNORM_HOLD5.ranking: rank four products by feature; product code ascending breaks exact ties
RATES_H1_XS_MOM5_VOLNORM_HOLD5.position: long highest feature product at +0.5 gross weight, short lowest at -0.5
RATES_H1_XS_MOM5_VOLNORM_HOLD5.sampling: sequential non-overlapping observations; next signal at exit session close

RATES_H2_XS_SHOCK1_REVERSION_HOLD2.feature: most recent same-contract daily log return divided by sample std of prior 20 same-contract daily log returns
RATES_H2_XS_SHOCK1_REVERSION_HOLD2.ranking: rank four products by feature; product code ascending breaks exact ties
RATES_H2_XS_SHOCK1_REVERSION_HOLD2.position: long lowest feature product at +0.5 gross weight, short highest at -0.5
RATES_H2_XS_SHOCK1_REVERSION_HOLD2.sampling: sequential non-overlapping observations; next signal at exit session close

RATES_H3_TS_TREND20_IVOL_HOLD5.signal: for each product, direction = sign(log(signal_close / close_20_valid_sessions_ago)); zero means no leg
RATES_H3_TS_TREND20_IVOL_HOLD5.volatility: sample std of prior 20 same-contract daily log returns
RATES_H3_TS_TREND20_IVOL_HOLD5.weights: inverse-volatility absolute weights across nonzero legs, normalized so sum(abs(weight))=1
RATES_H3_TS_TREND20_IVOL_HOLD5.sampling: sequential non-overlapping observations; next signal at exit session close
